blocks.text: SOC 1 is an independent CPA examination, not a certification
What is the difference between SOC 1 Type I and Type II?
Type I evaluates control design at a specified date
How is SOC 1 different from SOC 2?
SOC 1 focuses on controls relevant to user entities' internal control over financial reporting
How long is a Type II observation period?
The period is agreed with the independent CPA firm and reflects the assurance objective
Can Cybersentinels perform the SOC 1 examination?
No
